mapper.select: SELECT a.apr10_stamp_id AS stamp_id, a.apr10_stamp_id || '' AS stamp_id_string, a.apr10_stamp_nm AS stamp_name, a.apr10_use_nm AS use_name, f_org_nm(a.apr10_org_id, COALESCE(a.apr10_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyymmdd'))) AS org_name FROM apr10_stamp a WHERE a.apr10_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.apr10_stamp_id NOT IN ( SELECT dcr40_stamp_id FROM dcr40_stamp_auth WHERE dcr40_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND COALESCE(dcr40_except_yn, 'false') = 'true' ) AND UPPER(CONCAT(a.apr10_stamp_nm, a.apr10_use_nm, a.apr10_note, f_org_nm(a.apr10_org_id, COALESCE(a.apr10_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyymmdd'))))) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) AND ( a.apr10_all_use_yn = 'true' OR a.apr10_stamp_id IN ( SELECT org10_stamp_id FROM org10_role_stamp WHERE org10_org_code_id = #{orgId} ) ) AND f_today() BETWEEN a.apr10_start_date AND COALESCE(a.apr10_close_date, to_date('29991231','yyyymmdd')) ORDER BY a.apr10_stamp_nm
mapper.sql: a.apr10_stamp_id AS stamp_id , a.apr10_org_id AS org_id , f_org_nm(a.apr10_org_id, COALESCE(a.apr10_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyyMMdd'))) AS org_name , a.apr10_emp_id AS apr_emp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(a.apr10_emp_id) || ' ' || f_get_empTrans(a.apr10_emp_id, f_today()::date, 'pos_nm') AS apr_emp_name , a.apr10_second_emp_id AS second_emp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(a.apr10_second_emp_id) || ' ' || f_get_empTrans(a.apr10_second_emp_id, f_today()::date, 'pos_nm') AS second_emp_name , a.apr10_stamp_nm AS stamp_name , a.apr10_start_date::date AS start_date , a.apr10_close_date::date AS close_date , a.apr10_use_nm AS use_name , a.apr10_stamp_id || '' AS stamp_id_string , a.apr10_corp_stamp_yn AS corp_stamp_yn , a.apr10_step_use_yn AS step_use_yn , a.apr10_all_use_yn AS all_use_yn , ( SELECT ( CASE WHEN COUNT(org10_role_stamp.*) = 0 THEN '' WHEN COUNT(org10_role_stamp.*) = 1 THEN MIN(f_org_nm(org10_org_code_id, f_sysdate())) ELSE MIN(f_org_nm(org10_org_code_id, f_sysdate())) || ' 외 ' || COUNT(org10_role_stamp.*) - 1 || '건' END ) FROM org10_role_stamp WHERE org10_stamp_id = a.apr10_stamp_id ) AS role_name , ( SELECT COUNT(*) || '건' FROM dcr40_stamp_auth WHERE COALESCE(dcr40_except_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND dcr40_stamp_id = a.apr10_stamp_id ) AS stamp_auth_cnt_str , a.apr10_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM apr10_stamp a WHERE a.apr10_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY a.apr10_stamp_nm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr10_stamp (apr10_stamp_id, apr10_company_id, apr10_org_id, apr10_emp_id, apr10_second_emp_id, apr10_stamp_nm, apr10_start_date, apr10_close_date, apr10_use_nm, apr10_corp_stamp_yn, apr10_step_use_yn, apr10_all_use_yn, apr10_note) VALUES (#{r.stampId}, #{companyId}, #{r.orgId}, #{r.aprEmpId}, #{r.secondEmpId}, #{r.stampName}, #{r.startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{r.closeDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{r.useName}, #{r.corpStampYn}, #{r.stepUseYn}, #{r.allUseYn}, #{r.note})
mapper.update: UPDATE apr10_stamp SET apr10_org_id = #{r.orgId}, apr10_emp_id = #{r.aprEmpId}, apr10_second_emp_id = #{r.secondEmpId}, apr10_stamp_nm = #{r.stampName}, apr10_start_date = #{r.startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, apr10_close_date = #{r.closeDate, jdbcType=DATE}, apr10_use_nm = #{r.useName}, apr10_corp_stamp_yn = #{r.corpStampYn}, apr10_step_use_yn = #{r.stepUseYn}, apr10_all_use_yn = #{r.allUseYn}, apr10_note = #{r.note} WHERE apr10_stamp_id = #{r.stampId} AND apr10_company_id = #{companyId}
